browserCoverage: Create career via UI; annual tab; regular/national filter; expanded tournament game limits; current-year bounds; event detail and registration window.
Register actual 3-day event, advance calendar, watch real NPC engine moves, pause/reload/resume without spending player resources.
Read original completed World Circuit standings/pairings from year history; retain archive across reload.
Export/import full career including archives into a separate empty slot; original remains isolated; corrupt or occupied-slot restore rejected.
Regional hosts and existing expanded tournament human moves/round completion/reload regressions.
limitations: Live means a simulated chess board, not internet video streaming. Current live NPC games are in the player active tournament current playable round; player games still use the original match screen.
World Circuit is completed by the existing weekly simulation. Its historical results/pairings are available, but it never recorded live move sequences; no historical PGNs are invented.
Older missing events or discarded details cannot be reconstructed. Retained summaries are labelled and partial recordings do not claim to be complete games.
Year bounds follow in-game career time, not device date. A 2026 career hides 2027 until the career reaches 2027.

Browser tests use Chromium emulation, not a physical Termux, Android or iOS device. Main viewport 390x844; live-board screenshots 390x1200. Sticky navigation is hidden temporarily for panel screenshots.
